Bulletin — Earthquakes / Hazards — 2026-08-31 20:56 UTC Six M4.5+ tremors recorded in the past ~17 hours across the Pacific Rim and Latin America. M5.5 struck 44 km NNE of Ruteng, Indonesia at 08:03 UTC — the largest event of the day. Solomon Islands saw a M4.8 at 20:00 UTC, 176 km SE of Gizo. El Salvador registered a M4.6 at 18:56 UTC, 112 km SSW of Chirilagua. Peru logged a M4.7 at 11:53 UTC, 3 km NW of Yanacancha. The Kuril Islands recorded a M4.6 at 09:19 UTC, 28 km ESE of Kuril’sk. A M4.5 rattled the south of the Fiji Islands at 04:38 UTC. Magnitudes ranged from M4.5 to M5.5 across six events, with five clustered between M4.6 and M4.8. Activity spanned the Solomon Islands, Indonesia, the Kurils, Fiji, Peru, and Central America, consistent with circum-Pacific plate-boundary seismicity.
